new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/static/i18n.js:64-78: doAttrs honours data-i18n-dyn only on the element itself (:70), while doText checks closest('[data-i18n-dyn]') (:58). #home-tier (src/static/index.html:254) sits inside .home-glance[data-i18n-dyn] (:247) with no attribute of its own. walk.summary: Row T passes on the fixed build 0deff9c4, for everything a sandbox can reach. T1-T8 pass in en, fr, ar and zh, and the 375 px pass passes in en and ar (/tasks also in zh). T9 and T10 are not measurable here: no pass can run without egress, and there is no crawl history. All 7 confirmed row-T defects are fixed. The /tasks page now reads airplane mode correctly, fills and reddens its plane, shows the Q1126 offline title and 'Airplane mode', and stays offline after its own click. Its health pill reads healthy, its strip and tab title repaint within about 100 ms of a live switch, and it has no 375 px overflow. Home's tier wraps at 375 px. The coach re-anchors on a live or RTL switch and never covers the top bar. The cross-row fixes seen on this row's surfaces also hold: H1/O5/P1 (lane hovers above the consent popup), H2, H3, H7, N10, O2, O4, P2 (on the gauge), S7, H8, P7 and U5. There were no page errors, no console errors, no HTTP responses >= 400, no undefined/NaN/null/[object Object], and no non-loopback socket in four boots. I found seven new P3s. Four are stale or untranslated text: the gauge hover keeps the language of its last click; Home's tier caveat hover stays in its first-painted language (the i18n walker ignores an ancestor's data-i18n-dyn for attributes); after a live switch from fr, the Settings Collection toggle and Home's 'Most recent' empty state stay French; and the AI pill hover opens with English server text. The other three: a false '(server busy)' stamp on an idle Home; a blank 'Mode' row in the /tasks Schedule tab (the mode was retired); and a /tasks health dot that is grey in every state.

recheck.summary:
I re-checked all 7 of the walker's items on my own instance and confirmed all 7. I also found two new P3 defects.

Setup: a fresh `scripts/ui_clickthrough_seed.py --mini` seed (24 articles) in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/T-recheck/data, seeded with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE set and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset, so the database header is ciphertext. One server, PID 5791 on port 8977, ran from the read-only tree at 0deff9c4 with neither variable set. /api/system/lock-state read `locked` at boot and `unlocked-encrypted` after the real #pw / #btn-unlock form. The app stayed in airplane mode (/api/system/network online:false) the whole time, and no consent was accepted. None of my probes opened a consent popup, because the speed knob is a loopback write. An lsof monitor sampled the server once a second and saw zero non-loopback peers (egress-boot1.log). The server was stopped by PID, and `git status` in the tree is clean.

Browser: Chromium headless with the three prescribed flags and the proxy variables removed. Main viewport 1440x950. Languages en, fr, ar and zh, switched live and on cold loads, plus a 375 px pass of the /tasks Schedule tab. No page errors, console errors, HTTP responses of 400 or more, or undefined/NaN/null text in any probe.

Scripts and results are in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/T-recheck/ (rc_busy.py/.json, rc_i18n.py/.json, rc_tasks.py/.json, rc_extra.py/.json), with screenshots in shots/.

Items 1-3 are one family: an already-translated string is written where the i18n walker treats first sight as English, or where nothing repaints it on `oo:langchange`:
- **Item 1:** `_paintRateMode` is not called from the language-change listener.
- **Item 2:** the walker's `doAttrs` checks only the element's own `data-i18n-dyn`, not an ancestor's. It reverts the corpus-tier title about 110 ms after `renderCorpusTier` writes the new language, as a MutationObserver trace shows.
- **Item 3:** `textContent`/`innerHTML` is written through `t()`, so the walker caches a French text node as the "English original".

The other confirmed items:
- **Item 4:** the served cache keeps `built_at` on an idle server by design, so after 90 s the Home strip adds 'as of 10:25 AM (server busy)'. Measured beside scheduler running:false, phase null, online:false.
- **Item 5:** the retired `mode` field (b45bed19, 2026-09-25) still has a row on the /tasks Schedule tab, with an empty value.
- **Item 6:** the /tasks health dot has no ok/err class, so it is grey where the app's is green.
- **Item 7:** the AI pill's hover leads with the server's English `backend_reason` in every locale. I found no ruling that keeps it English.

New:
- /tasks ignores the app's theme. It reads localStorage 'oo.theme', which nothing writes; the app stores 'oo.ui'.
- Home's 'Most recent' heading is squeezed onto two lines at 1440 px by a full-width select. In zh it breaks one character per line.

- Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/T-recheck/shots/B-rate-hover-ar-after-fr-clicks.png. The French bubble sits on the Arabic top bar.
- Also B-rate-hover-zh-after-fr-clicks.png and B-rate-hover-en-after-fr-clicks.png.
- Control (phase A, knob never clicked, English boot paint): the ar, fr and zh hovers are correctly translated, e.g. ar 'سرعة الجمع: الحد الأقصى — …', because the bubble translates the English title on display.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-sources.js:1042-1055 (`_paintRateMode`, title written at :1051) writes a t()-translated title on a button that carries `data-i18n-dyn` (src/static/index.html:138), so the i18n walker never retranslates it. The `oo:langchange` listener (src/static/app-boot.js:41-309) repaints the Wikipedia toggle (:116), the AI pill (:120) and the plane (:289), but never `_paintRateMode`. The first paint happens in `loadRateMode` before the locale loads, which keeps the title English and hides the bug until the first click.
items.suggested_fix: In the app-boot.js `oo:langchange` listener add `try { if (typeof _paintRateMode === "function" && _rateMode) _paintRateMode(_rateMode); } catch (_e) {}`, next to the `_paintWikiLane` repaint. Also repaint once on `OOI18N.ready` so the boot paint is in the UI language. Add a node test: paint in fr, switch to ar, and assert the title is the ar value.

items.ref: new:Home's corpus-tier hover (the caveat's long form with the thresholds) stays in the language it was first painted in
items.evidence:
rc_i18n.json:
- Phase A (start in en): after live switches to ar, fr and zh, the tier hover reads 'Early corpus — Early stage: the Leads rest on thin evidence … Thresholds: early is below 200 articles or 14 days…'. The visible badge does translate, e.g. 'CORPUS NAISSANT … preuves minces — à lire avec prudence'.
- Phase B (cold fr, then ar, zh, en): the hover reads 'Corpus naissant — Stade précoce : …' in all three.
- A MutationObserver on the title attribute shows the mechanism. At t=19265 ms renderCorpusTier writes 'مجموعة ناشئة — مرحلة مبكرة…'; at t=19375 ms the title is reverted to 'Early corpus — …'. In phase B the Arabic, Chinese and English writes are each reverted to 'Corpus naissant — …'.
- The hover is correct only on a cold load: fr cold and ar cold are right.
- Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/T-recheck/shots/A-tier-hover-fr-live-from-en.png, an English bubble under the French badge. Also B-home-tier-hover-{ar,zh,en}-after-fr-cold.png.
items.root_cause: src/static/i18n.js:64-79. `doAttrs` skips only an element that carries `data-i18n-dyn` itself (:70), while `doText` honours an ancestor (:58, `p.closest("[data-i18n-dyn]")`). #home-tier (src/static/index.html:254) sits inside `.home-glance[data-i18n-dyn]` (:247) but has no marker of its own. renderCorpusTier (src/static/app-home.js:1058) sets a translated composite title, then rewrites innerHTML (:1062), which fires the childList observer. apply() then restores `tr(first-seen title)`. The composite of three keyed fragments matches no key, so the title reverts to whichever language painted it first (i18n.js:74-77).
items.suggested_fix: Narrow fix: give #home-tier its own `data-i18n-dyn`, in the markup or in renderCorpusTier via `el.setAttribute('data-i18n-dyn','')`. renderCorpusTier already re-runs on `oo:langchange` through loadBriefing. Broader fix: make `doAttrs` honour an ancestor, e.g. `if (el.closest && el.closest('[data-i18n-dyn]')) return;`, to match `doText`. That one needs an audit of static titles inside dyn containers first. Add a node test: switch fr, then ar, and assert the title stays the ar composite after the debounced apply.

items.ref: new:Text painted in a non-English language stays after a live switch: the Settings Collection toggle (T6's path) and Home's 'Most recent' empty state
items.evidence:
rc_i18n.json, phase B (cold fr; Settings > Advanced > Collection opened, then Home; then live switch):
- #collect-toggle reads 'La collecte est DÉSACTIVÉE — cliquez pour l'activer' in ar, zh and en, even after reopening Settings > Advanced > Collection. Its hover is correctly Arabic, 'شغّل أو أوقف الجمع المستمر في الخلفية', and Chinese, '开启或关闭持续性后台采集'.
- #home-recent reads 'Aucun article pour cette étiquette pour l'instant.' in ar, zh and en, even after leaving Home and coming back.
- Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/T-recheck/shots/B-collect-toggle-ar.png (a French button on the Arabic Settings page) and B-home-recent-zh.png (a French line in the Chinese panel).
- Control (phase A, starting in en): both translate correctly in ar, fr and zh ('الجمع مُتوقف — انقر للتفعيل', '该标签暂无文章。').
items.root_cause: src/static/app-sources.js:1498-1506. `_paintCollectToggle` sets `btn.textContent = t9(...)` at :1503. This creates a new text node whose first-seen value is already French, and the walker records first sight as the English original (src/static/i18n.js:59-60). tr(French) matches no key, so the text stays French in every later language, and nothing in the `oo:langchange` listener (app-boot.js:41-309) repaints it. The same happens in src/static/app-home.js:725 (loadHomeRecentList: `box.innerHTML = ... esc(t("No articles for this tag yet."))`). Neither surface is re-run by a revisit either: loadScheduler is guarded by the section's loaded flag, and Home does not reload the recent list.
items.suggested_fix: Two options for both surfaces. (a) Write the English key and let the walker translate it: `btn.textContent = running ? "Collection is ON — click to turn off" : "Collection is OFF — click to turn on"`, and likewise the plain English empty-state string. The walker translates exact keys on first sight and on every switch. (b) Keep t(), remember the last state (running flag, last recent-list outcome), and repaint both from the `oo:langchange` listener. (a) is the smaller change for exact-key strings. Pin it with a node test that paints in fr and switches to ar.

items.ref: new:Home's at-a-glance strip says 'as of HH:MM (server busy)' on an idle server
items.evidence:
rc_busy.json:
- After unlock the app stays on Home with nothing running: /api/scheduler/status running:false, /api/scheduler/activity {running:false, active:false, phase:null, online:false}, airplane mode.
- /api/database/stats as_of stays '2026-09-27T10:25:16+00:00' while cache_age_s grows 18, 36, 54, 72, 90, 96 across 18 s samples, with cached:true and cache_ttl_s 30.
- After a reload at age 96 s the strip reads '… 10 MENTIONED DATES as of 10:25 AM (server busy)'. In fr it reads 'à 10:25 (serveur occupé)', in ar 'حتى 10:25 ص (الخادم مشغول)', in zh '截至 10:25（服务器繁忙）'.
- Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/T-recheck/shots/busy-home-en-reload.png. 'Automatic collection: stopped' sits two lines under '(server busy)'.
- The cache's own comment says the idle value 'is still exactly right'.
- Severity P2 rather than P3: the stamp states a false reason about the system's state on the app's default path (offline, idle, more than 90 s after the last write).
items.root_cause: src/static/app-home.js:113-138. `homeStatsAgeNote` appends t("as of {time} (server busy)") whenever `cache_age_s >= 90` (:117, :120, :137). src/api/served_cache.py:235-244 deliberately leaves `built_at`, and therefore `as_of` and `cache_age_s` (:146-152), untouched when the change probe shows no write, i.e. on an idle server. It only re-stamps `checked_at`, which the payload never exposes. So on an idle server the age grows without bound and the note fires with a reason nothing measured.
items.suggested_fix: Expose the verification in the payload. `_decorate` can add `verified_age_s` (now − checked_at) or `refresh_pending: bool` (true when the probe differed and a background rebuild was kicked). The Home note should key on that: show nothing when the value was verified unchanged, and only when a rebuild is pending say 'as of {time} (refreshing)'. Never give 'server busy' as a reason unless it is measured. Keep the 90 s threshold for the pending case.

items.ref: new:The task manager's Schedule tab shows a 'Mode' row with an empty value
items.evidence:
rc_tasks.json:
- /tasks opened through the real #tm-open icon. On the Schedule tab the rows are State, Current pass, Cadence, Next pass, Last run, and then {'k':'Mode','v':''}.
- The row appears in every locale: fr 'Mode' / '', ar 'الوضع' / '', zh '模式' / ''. At 375 px too.
- /api/scheduler/activity has no 'mode' key (keys: active, collect_perf, concurrency, …, settings, started_at). settings has no 'mode' (retired_mode ''), and /api/scheduler/config has no 'mode'.
- Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/T-recheck/shots/tasks-schedule-en.png and tasks-schedule-ar.png ('الوضع' with nothing beside it).
items.root_cause: src/static/taskmanager.html:568 renders `row(t("Mode"), esc(s.mode || a.mode || ""))`. The scheduler `mode` field was retired in b45bed19 (2026-09-25, Q1020 = a and Q716 = a; see src/scheduler/settings.py:21-26), so neither `settings.mode` nor `activity.mode` exists any more and the value is always empty. The in-app window's copy carries the same dead row (src/static/app-core.js:2401, `modeHtml`), although that popover no longer appears to be opened by anything.
items.suggested_fix: Remove the Mode row from taskmanager.html:568 and from app-core.js:2401, along with the `modeHtml` concatenation. Add a test pinning that no Schedule renderer reads `s.mode` or `a.mode`.

items.ref: new:The task manager's health dot is grey in every state
items.evidence:
rc_tasks.json:
- The app's top bar has #health .dot with class 'dot ok', background rgb(46,139,87), label 'healthy'.
- /tasks on the same server has class 'dot', background rgb(140,149,166). That is exactly --muted (#8c95a6), with no shadow, beside 'healthy' / 'sain' / 'سليم' / '正常'.
- /api/health returns {status:'healthy'}.
- Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/T-recheck/shots/tasks-en-topbar.png and tasks-schedule-ar.png (grey dot) against tasks-app-topbar-en.png (green dot).
- The first-walk T2 root cause already noted that 'the dot also never gets an ok or err class'. B8 fixed only the label.
items.root_cause: src/static/taskmanager.html:950-955. `paintHealth` writes `' ' + label` with no state class, so app.css:521 `.dot { background: var(--muted) }` applies in every state. The app adds `dot ok` / `dot err` (src/static/app-core.js:2874-2880).
items.suggested_fix: In paintHealth, map the state to a class: `var cls = {healthy: "ok", degraded: "warn", offline: "err"}[_healthState] || ""; el.innerHTML = ' ' + esc(label);`. taskmanager.html already loads app.css (:32), so .dot.ok, .dot.warn and .dot.err apply as-is.

items.ref: new:The AI pill's hover opens with an English server sentence on fr, ar and zh pages
items.evidence:
rc_i18n.json:
- /api/llm/health returns backend_reason 'no GPU detected (or vLLM unavailable), and Ollama is NOT reachable either -- no AI backend is reachable right now'.
- The #llm hover in fr reads 'no GPU detected (or vLLM unavailable), and Ollama is NOT reachable either -- no AI backend is reachable right now — L'IA est hors ligne — cliquez pour la démarrer…'.
- The same English lead appears in ar ('… — الذكاء الاصطناعي غير متصل — …') and zh ('… — AI 离线 — …'), both after live switches and after a cold fr load.
- Only the trailing t() sentence translates.
- I found no ruling that server prose stays English. The ledger search found none, and the 2026-09-26 known list does not include it. The code comment calls it a V4 engineering choice ('English server text, the same class as h.detail'), while the B-batches moved other server prose to keyed twins (title_i18n, label_i18n, detail_i18n, paused_reason_i18n).
items.root_cause: src/static/app-ai-tools.js:963-965 prefixes the pill title with `h.backend_reason || h.detail` verbatim. The reason is English prose composed at runtime in src/llm/backend.py:846-864 (e.g. :850 selection and :863 `f"{selection}, and Ollama is NOT reachable either -- {NO_BACKEND_REASON}"`) and passed through by src/api/llm.py:498/528/538 with no key or code beside it.
items.suggested_fix: Have resolve_backend and /api/llm/health emit a stable reason code, or a `backend_reason_i18n` frame plus vars (selection and fallback as keyed sentences), next to the unchanged English `backend_reason` that the tests substring-pin. The pill then composes the lead with tf() and adds the keys x12. As an interim step, show only the translated t() sentence on non-en pages and keep the English server reason in AI settings or diagnostics.

items.ref: new:The task manager page (/tasks) ignores the app's theme and always renders Ink
items.evidence:
rc_extra.json:
- In the app, Settings > Graphics > Paper gives data-theme 'paper' and body background rgb(242,238,228). /tasks, opened through #tm-open in the same browser context, gives no data-theme (Ink) and body background rgb(12,14,19).
- The same with Solar: app 'solar' / rgb(0,43,54), /tasks Ink.
- It also happens with the default 'System' theme, which headless renders as light.
- localStorage holds oo.ui = {"theme":"paper",…} and oo.theme = null.
- Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/T-recheck/shots/extra-app-paper.png (a light Paper app) against extra-tasks-with-app-paper.png (a dark /tasks page).
- Not in defects.csv or the OPEN_QUEUE known list.
items.root_cause: src/static/taskmanager.html:212-215 reads `localStorage.getItem("oo.theme")`, a key nothing in the app writes. `git log -S'"oo.theme"'` shows the key only ever existed in taskmanager.html (3c617bdd). The app keeps its look in `oo.ui` as JSON with a `.theme` field (src/static/app-shell.js:227, :254-263), and maps 'system' and 'ink' through applyThemeAttr.
items.suggested_fix: In taskmanager.html read `JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('oo.ui')||'{}').theme` and apply the same mapping as applyThemeAttr: 'system' follows prefers-color-scheme (light gives 'light'), 'ink' or empty removes the attribute, anything else sets data-theme. Optionally also apply accent, face and density. A `storage` event listener would let an open /tasks tab follow a theme change.

items.ref: new:Home's 'Most recent' heading is squeezed onto two lines at 1440 px (one character per line in zh)
items.evidence:
rc_extra.json at 1440x950, #home-recent-panel h2:
- en 'Most recent': 102 px wide, 53 px tall, 2 lines.
- fr 'Les plus récents': 134 px, 2 lines.
- zh '最新': 32 px, 2 lines, one character per line.
- The tag select beside it takes the rest of the ~1130 px row.
- Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/T-recheck/shots/extra-home-recent-zh.png, and A-tier-hover-fr-live-from-en.png ('Les plus / récents').
- Cosmetic, and it predates this build, but it is visible on Home in every language and not in defects.csv.
items.root_cause: src/static/app.css:431-433 (`.phead { display:flex }`, where `.phead h2` can shrink) together with app.css:435 (`input, select, textarea { width:100% }`). The full-width #home-recent-tag select (src/static/index.html:301-302) squeezes the shrinkable h2 down to its min-content width. CJK can break between any two characters, hence '最/新'.
items.suggested_fix: Make the heading non-shrinking with `.phead h2 { flex: none; white-space: nowrap; }`, or limit the select: `#home-recent-tag { width: auto; max-width: 60%; }`. Check the 375 px layout afterwards, since the .phead row may need to wrap there.
